newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow on Friday, USDA said. Few slaughter steers steady, but not well established, no slaughter heifer sales confirmed.
Inquiry moderate, demand fair. Feedlots current. Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers Friday.
Last week's confirmed sales 101,700 head, including 32,600 head or about 32 perecnt percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. Slaughter steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1300 lbs 63.00. Confirmed - 200 last week - none last year - none
